title: Animal file (data/animals/<id>.json, one kind per file)
description: A kind of animal the hero keeps on his land (the Homestead, phase 4; TECH_DESIGN §30): the building it lives in, what it gives and how often, the pasture grass it eats, and its sound. Herd (core/homestead/herd.gd) reads it. Fed and petted it gives every `every` mornings; fed only, at half that pace; unfed, nothing that morning. It is fed each morning by its building's pasture (Pasture), else by one hay from the silo. Farmer Oda sells it (data/shops/oda.json, a ware naming it as `animal`).

lives_in.description: The building it lives in (data/buildings), one with room for animals: its `animals`, or its upgrade's. Kinds may share a building (sheep and cows, the barn).

gives.description: The item it gives (data/items): an egg, wool, milk. Taken with a right click, if the pack has room; else it waits, and stops the next.

every.description: The mornings between one product and the next when it is fed and petted.

grazes.description: The cells of pasture grass it eats in a morning.

sound.description: The sound effect it makes when petted (Audio.SFX): cluck, bleat, low.
